case_title: LUCIA NAVARRO VS. MARIA ROSALINA GONZALEZ ET AL.

docket_entries.description: SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF OCT-16-2018 - JUDGMENT.

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF NAVARRO, LUCIA RECOVER FROM DEFENDANT GONZALEZ, MARIA ROSALINA AKA  ROSALINA GONZALEZ GONZALEZ, RAFAEL $600.00 PRINCIPAL, $11.18 INTEREST, TOTAL JUDGMENT $611.18, DEFENDANTS ARE JOINTLY AND SEVERALLY LIABLE AND SHALL PAY $600.00 (RETURN SECURITY DEPOSIT) PLUS INTEREST AND COSTS. THE COST OF CHANGING THE LOCKS IS DISALLOWED BECAUSE THE RECEIPT POSTDATES THE MOVEOUT DATE AND THE BURDEN IS ON THE LANDLORD TO SUBSTANTIATE COSTS. STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS NO EXHIBITS FILED
